title: The Card Companion
intro: Every card in the game, in English, Spanish and French, side by side. The printed cards are in English; the Card Companion lets a table play in Spanish or French by finding each card by its number. Each card has space for your own notes. Download it and print it, like the player booklet.
pages_hint: A few of its pages. Pick one to read it up close.
